choices.result_text: Honesty is acknowledged, and a better plan replaces quiet fear; the ruling on the broken promise is firm enough to matter and humane enough for the exhausted apprentice to remember.

choices.label: Require restitution
choices.result_text: Restitution repairs the damage and turns regret into useful action; the matter of the broken promise ends with less fear and more honesty for the exhausted apprentice.

choices.label: Use the confession
choices.result_text: The confession becomes leverage, producing obedience and distrust — the answer to the broken promise is defensible on paper and difficult to defend to the exhausted apprentice.

title: Enemy in Need — Exhausted Apprentice
description: An exhausted apprentice encounters an injured rival beyond the reach of either side's allies. Everyone involved with the exhausted apprentice understands that the easy answer to the enemy in need may not be the right one.

choices.label: Give aid
choices.result_text: Aid is given without surrendering caution, and the rivalry changes shape — the handling of the enemy in need shows the exhausted apprentice that restraint can be stronger than advantage.

choices.label: Call both sides
choices.result_text: Both sides arrive under a temporary truce enforced by practical necessity; the decision in the enemy in need preserves dignity and gives the exhausted apprentice a responsible path forward.

choices.label: Take advantage
choices.result_text: The advantage is taken, but witnesses remember the choice longer than the victory — the choice surrounding the enemy in need solves the moment and weakens the trust of the exhausted apprentice for much longer.
